news.title: Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited (BSE:531126) agreed to acquire Agnetta International Pvt. Ltd. for INR 35 million.
news.body:
Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited (BSE:531126) agreed to acquire Agnetta International Pvt. Ltd. for INR 35 million on March 3, 2026. The consideration consists of common equity of Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited having a value of INR 35 million to be issued for common equity of Agnetta International Pvt. Ltd. As part of consideration, INR 35 million is paid towards common equity of Agnetta International Pvt. Ltd. In a related transaction Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited agreed to acquire remaining 2% stake in Empyrean Spirits Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Agnetta International Pvt. Ltd. reported total revenue of INR 60.4 million. As of March 31, 2025, Agnetta International Pvt. Ltd. reported total common equity of INR 26.8 million.

The transaction is subject to approval

news.title: Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited Appoints Natasha Goyal as Non-Executive Independent Director
news.body: Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited at its Extraordinary General Meeting held on 20 February 2026 appointed Natasha Goyal as Non-Executive Independent Director of the company.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 3 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 3 independent directors. 4 non-independent directors. Additional Non-Executive Independent Director Sanjay Jain was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.79 loss per share (vs ₹0.52 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.79 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.52 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹26.0m (down 40% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹28.2m (loss widened 149% from 3Q 2025).
